Task: Managed Log Query / Log Ingestion

Write Python code that writes a structured JSON log event to a managed logging service using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from google.cloud import logging

# This script assumes you have authenticated with the Google Cloud CLI
# and set a default project.
#
# 1. Install the client library:
#    pip install google-cloud-logging
#
# 2. Authenticate and configure your project:
#    gcloud auth application-default login
#    gcloud config set project YOUR_GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID

# Instantiate a client for Google Cloud Logging.
# The client will automatically use the project ID from the environment.
logging_client = logging.Client()

# The name of the log to write to. This will appear in the Logs Explorer.
log_name = "structured-app-events"

# Get a logger instance.
logger = logging_client.logger(log_name)

# Define the structured log payload as a Python dictionary.
# This will be ingested as the `jsonPayload` field in the log entry.
log_payload = {
    "message": "User authentication successful",
    "user_id": "user-9876",
    "request_id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-1234-567890abcdef",
    "source_ip": "203.0.113.45",
    "service_context": {
        "service": "auth-api",
        "version": "2.1.0"
    }
}

# Write the structured log entry.
# The `log_struct` method sends a JSON payload.
logger.log_struct(log_payload, severity="INFO")

print(f"Successfully wrote structured log to '{log_name}' in project '{logging_client.project}'.")
